projects.name: Tide Clock
projects.summary: A wall clock that shows the local tide instead of the hour.
projects.now: The dial, tide curve and moon phase draw correctly. The station picker lists nearby stations but doesn't save the choice yet.
projects.nextStep: Save the chosen station and redraw the dial from it.
calls: Choose between the two dial designs in docs/dials.md
Approve the free tide API's attribution line
projects.about:
A wall clock with one hand that follows the tide instead of the hour: high water at the top, low water at the bottom. It reads the nearest station's predictions and redraws the water level every few minutes.

Made for a kitchen wall by the sea, but any coastal station works.

projects.name: Loom Sim
projects.summary: A jacquard loom simulator that weaves patterns from punch-card files.
projects.now: The weaving engine renders plain weave and twill. Pattern files load; the editor is next.
projects.nextStep: Start the pattern editor: click cells to lift warp threads.
projects.about: A simulator of a jacquard loom. It reads punch-card pattern files, lifts the threads card by card, and weaves the cloth on screen, so you can see how a pattern turns into fabric.
